assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13, partial close): 3.3.1's collection gap is now mostly closed (Key Vault, storage, SQL database, CAE diagnosticSettings plus the subscription Activity Log all land in the same Log Analytics workspace), so cross-resource correlation across the Azure plane is now possible in KQL against a single workspace, and lawDataRetentionDays is raised 30 -> 90 (platform/main.bicep), meeting the AU-11 convention and DFARS 252.204-7012(e)'s 90-day preservation obligation for that data. What review/analysis/reporting still cannot reach: Entra ID SignInLogs and AuditLogs, which remain unrouted (same live-tenant-verification blocker recorded against 3.3.1/3.3.2). Correlating a suspicious Key Vault AuditEvent or SQL query against WHO authenticated to get there, or against a Conditional Access decision, is not possible until that routing exists. Note this control's gap is bounded by whichever of 3.3.1/3.3.2 is worse at any time, not independent of them — it stays open for the same reason.

recommendation: Route Entra ID SignInLogs and AuditLogs to the Log Analytics workspace once the Microsoft.aadiam tenant-scoped resource shape and required Entra role can be verified against a live tenant, so identity-plane events can be correlated alongside the resource-plane events already landing in the same workspace. Collection, correlation capacity and retention for everything else Task 13 could reach are DONE.
